snippet.title: “REINES DU SABBAT Queen of Sacrifice.” Trailer – RPG Developer Bakin Sample Game
snippet.description:
The creator of the popular horror game “Corpse Party,” KEDOUIN, has released the sample game “REINES DU SABBAT Queen of Sacrifice.,” created using Bakin, for free on the official website. Along with this release, the game project data and related assets for this title have been implemented into the Bakin itself at no additional cost.

“REINES DU SABBAT Queen of Sacrifice.” is a 3D & 2D fantasy-adventure game that reconstructs the prologue of KEDOUIN’s debut work “REINES DU SABBAT” using Bakin. While grappling with a “game creation tool capable of handling 3D” for the first time, KEDOUIN successfully built his distinctive worldview using the core features available up through Update Ver. 2.2. Although the estimated playtime is about one hour, the game is packed with many elements that can serve as inspiration for game creation, including maps, events, characters, sound, and mini-games.
We hope that Bakin users will not only make use of the assets included in this game, but also draw inspiration from its world and scenario for their own creative projects.
Details on the production process of this sample game are also introduced on the development blog “Made with RPG Developer Bakin,” so please be sure to check it out as well.

 - “REINES DU SABBAT Queen of Sacrifice.” Special Page (Download the game here)
https://rpgbakin.com/en/products/reines-du-sabbat-queen-of-sacrifice/

-  “REINES DU SABBAT” Development Blog: Made with RPG Developer Bakin 
https://rpgbakin.com/en/blog/made-with-bakin/

- “REINES DU SABBAT Queen of Sacrifice.” Game Overview
Title: REINES DU SABBAT Queen of Sacrifice.
Genre: Mystic Adventure
Recommended System Requirements:
OS: Windows10 (64bit), CPU: Core i5-8400/Ryzen 5 1500X or better, Memory: 16GB, Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce™ GTX1650/AMD Radeon™ RX570, Storage: 500 MB available space
Distribution Site: RPG Developer Bakin Official Website
Number of Players: 1 
Online Support: Not Supported 
Supported Languages: Japanese, English and Simplified Chinese (Traditional Chinese support planned for a later date.)
Price: Free
Release Date: December 16, 2025
Development: MAKOTO KEDOUIN / SmileBoom Co.Ltd.
Publisher: SmileBoom Co.Ltd.
Special Page: https://rpgbakin.com/en/products/reines-du-sabbat-queen-of-sacrifice/
